> Work out which layer rejected it.

Check your web server error log: nginx logs `client sent too long header line` for oversized cookies and headers, and `client sent invalid request` for a malformed request line or bad URL characters. If the log is clean, your application produced the 400 and the cause is in its validation, usually malformed JSON or a missing required field. The single most common real-world cause on websites is a cookie that has grown too large, which is why the page often works in a private window.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/400-bad-request/
